race.comment: NEWHAVEN PRINCE (3) was just fair in his latest trial, though his form at the end of last campaign makes for good reading. First-up over 1300m here is a good move and he showed good early speed and the end of last preparation. Can return with a bang. ALL THE STARS (6) led them up last start at Pinjarra and was only gunned down late when missing by 0.7L. He can roll forward from the draw again and give them something to catch. THE ROCKET (1) finished off nicely first-up at Northam and looks better suited out in trip now. The wide draw is a query, but it wouldn't surprise to see him fly over the top to score. PANCHO'S PLACE (2)  is third-up here and can feature in the finish again.
